'''Hana Takeda''' (Japanese: '''武田華''' ''Takeda Hana'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Takeda was born on August 23 in {{wp|Kanagawa}}, Japan and became an actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}}, during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced several roles including a young {{Ash}} and [[Goh's Grookey]].
